extendedMetrics.label: Buyback (this quarter or YTD if only YTD disclosed)

source.quote: the Company repurchased $47 million, or 2.7 million shares, of common stock at a weighted average share price of $17.46
Operating results equaled reported results as there were no significant items impacting earnings for the periods presented
Net interest margin (FTE) (non-GAAP) equaled 3.25%, stable to the first quarter 2026 level
The Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) regulatory capital ratio ended the quarter at 11.4% (estimated)
Return on average tangible common equity (1) 14.07 13.20 13.57
net charge-offs of $17.0 million, or 0.19% annualized of total average loans
Provision for credit losses was $21.4 million, an increase of $2.9 million from the prior quarter
